'Co-led' means the member was one of 5 or fewer original cosponsors. 'stages' gives the first date of each key action (reported by committee, passed House, passed Senate, presented to the President, vetoed, became law); 'law' is the public law number. Bills whose text was folded into a different law are not counted as becoming law. 'cosponsored' counts every bill the member cosponsored, co-led or not.
